decisions.reason: As a low-cost add-on to the firm’s core web and hosting business, premium customer support still has option value and is worth keeping unless demand has clearly disappointed.
The version management tool appears closely tied to the firm’s existing service stack, so keeping it remains attractive because it can deepen customer retention at moderate incremental cost.

The data processing contract tool is useful but less central to the firm’s core business and likely requires ongoing legal and content maintenance, so after several years the option is more likely to be abandoned if scale has not materialized.

Scalable hosting for agencies was prominently positioned at launch, fits the firm’s core capabilities, and still offers meaningful upside in recurring B2B revenue, so management would likely keep it on the market.
